hero.h1: Venkatesh Villa Gorai: Private 4BHK Villa near Gorai Beach, Mumbai
hero.subline: Weekend stays, birthdays, haldi & mehendi, anniversaries and team outings, with a lawn, rooftop gazebo and sunset views.

stays.heading: Weekend stays in Gorai
stays.intro: Venkatesh Villa Gorai is rented out to one group at a time, so the whole 4BHK villa, lawn and rooftop are yours alone for the stay. It's a short drive from Gorai Beach, built for families and friend groups who want a quiet break without leaving Mumbai.
stays.roomsSummary: 4 bedrooms · 3 bathrooms · living & dining area · fully-equipped kitchen
included: 4 comfortable bedrooms across two floors, with the entire villa reserved for your group only
Open lawn, garden swing and rooftop terrace with a gazebo for sunset hangouts
Badminton and table tennis for the group
Fully-equipped kitchen for your own cooking, plus a caretaker on-site for assistance
On-site parking and a gated, walled compound
stays.priceNote: Rates vary by date & group size; ask on WhatsApp for a quote.
stays.capacityNote: Comfortably sleeps up to 15 guests overnight.

celebrations.heading: Birthday parties, haldi & mehendi at our villa
celebrations.intro: Our lawn, rooftop terrace and dining deck welcome 50+ guests for day events, with seating and space already in place.
celebrations.partnerNote: In-house décor & catering available, or bring your own setup.

cards.title: Birthday parties

cards.title: Engagement

cards.title: Intimate weddings

cards.title: Day picnic

cards.title: New Year's Eve

nearby.heading: Nearby attractions in Gorai
nearby.intro: Gorai Beach, the Global Vipassana Pagoda and EsselWorld are all a short ride from the villa.

location.heading: How to reach Venkatesh Villa from Borivali
location.intro: Venkatesh Villa Gorai sits in Culvem Village, Gorai, just a 5-minute drive from Gorai Beach.

howToReachSteps.label: Auto
howToReachSteps.text: From Borivali (West) station, take an auto to Gorai Jetty.

howToReachSteps.label: Ferry · 5 min
howToReachSteps.text: A short ferry ride takes you across the creek to the Gorai side.

howToReachSteps.label: Auto · 15 min
howToReachSteps.text: Another auto from the jetty gets you to the villa in about 15 minutes.

location.byCarNote: Driving instead? Tap "Get directions" and Google Maps will pick the best road route at that time.
location.beachNote: Gorai Beach is just a 5-minute drive from the villa.
